A pupil of Geofroy Tory, Garamond was the foremost type de- 
signer and letter cutter of his time (as 10-1561).

text: It is believed that he based his letters on the Venetian models although he has introduced a number of important differences, and it is to Garamond that we owe the letter which we know as Old Style.

It is believed 
that he based his letters on the Venetian models although he 
has introduced a number of important differences, and it is to 
Garamond that we owe the letter which we know as Old Style.

text: In adapting this type to modern usage Mr. Goudy has not attempted an exact duplication of any of the Garamond models, and he has combined all the characteristics of the original design with the unmistakable Goudy touch.
